title: My fitness watch logged eight hours of sleep on Tuesday. I was at work, and it was on my nightstand.
transcript:
My fitness watch logged eight hours of sleep on Tuesday. I was at work, and it was on my nightstand. I noticed it Wednesday morning. Sleep score, eighty-one. Fell asleep at eleven forty, woke at seven. Resting heart rate, fifty-two. Mine never goes under sixty.

I was at the warehouse that whole night. The watch was charging next to my bed, in an apartment where I live alone.

I told myself it was a glitch. So that night I wore it to bed, and in the morning it showed two sleep sessions, side by side, at the exact same time. One heart rate was mine. The other one was fifty-two.

I started leaving it in a kitchen drawer. Every morning it was back on the nightstand, charging, with the strap buckled on the last notch. I've never used the last notch. My wrists are too small for it.

Friday, I checked the step counter. Two hundred and six steps, all between three and four in the morning. The map showed a tiny loop. Bed, hallway, kitchen drawer, hallway, bed.

Last night I didn't sleep at all. I lay there in the dark with the watch on my wrist, and at three exactly, it buzzed.

A new notification.

Welcome back. Two users detected.

Swipe to switch.
